comment: Boxes, slow cars, their placement rule and the avoidance session's schedule. The four frozen keys of the contract come first; every other key is the obstacle model's own. Every number is a starting value of the obstacle model unless 'provenance' says it was measured.

provenance.box_floor_friction: estimate: cardboard on dry concrete or carpet, sliding friction 0.4-0.5; no measurement
provenance.slow_car_mode: chosen by gate G3 by the pre-registered rule: no veto for either mode; dynamic costs 0.025-0.028 s CPU per simulated second more than mocap for two cars (a second machine), both bit-identical on two CPUs, dynamic passes momentum on in contacts (ratio 0.82-0.99), mocap acts as a moving wall
provenance.tail_box_centre_m: measured on the owner's model (per-part OBJ, faces subdivided to 2 mm): an open-bottom 0.12 x 0.12 x 0.20 m box with its front face at x 0.026 (2 mm behind the motor controller board at 0.0281) rests on the platform deck at z 0.07016 and holds the rear wing, rear body posts, WiFi antennas, antenna mount and rear damper stay inside; rear face at x -0.094 (0.041 m behind the rearmost point). The contract's starting value (0.020, 0, 0.170) would stand on the rear wing at z 0.1525 and cut the motor controller and power boards
provenance.entry_min_gap_m: estimate: 1.2 s at the reference car's 5 m/s, so a car that enters is never closer than that to the ego car along the track
provenance.putback_err_m: the grader configuration's staff.putback_err_m (starting value 0.03); a test keeps them equal
provenance.box.size_range_m: the rules' upper bound 35 x 32 x 30 cm; lower bounds 25 x 20 x 20 cm are an estimate of the boxes in the event photos, and keep every box above 8 beams at 3 m (gate G1) and its top above the scan plane at 2 deg of pitch at 3 m
provenance.box.inertia: a thin-walled box of uniform areal density (an empty cardboard box), scaled to mass_kg
provenance.tail_box.mass_kg: estimate: 0.1248 m^2 of single-wall corrugated board at about 0.4 kg/m^2
provenance.slow_cars.speed_factor_range: The design (35-50 % of the reference speed profile)
provenance.slow_cars.gap_keep_m: The design (slows when anything is within 0.8 m ahead)
provenance.speed.ref_speed_factor: a factor on SPEED, as the reference program's heat 2 (the reference program's implementation: every grip-dependent capability x f^2), f = 0.93 final; 1.0 named it ref_grip_factor and used sqrt(f mu g / kappa), which gave about 5 % more corner speed (sqrt(1 / (0.93 x 0.975)) = 1.050)
provenance.speed.lateral_frac_of_grip_g: 0.975: the lateral capacity the reference program's planner uses (the drive model's steady lateral limit 0.974-0.977 mu g)
provenance.speed.traction_frac_of_grip_g: 0.95: the reference program's traction fraction; the forward limit is min(accel_max_mps2, 0.95 f^2 mu g)
provenance.speed.brake_frac_of_grip_g: 1.0: the reference program's braking fraction (full braking decelerates at mu g)
provenance.path: The obstacle model's own starting values: clearances from the car's side to a wall face and to a box, the weight that blends a curvature-minimising line with the centreline (drawn per car, log-uniform)
provenance.follower: The obstacle model's own starting values of the privileged follower (pure pursuit, speed law, detection band)
provenance.staff: The obstacle model's own starting values: when the staff pick up a slow car that is stuck, rolled or off its path, and where they put it
provenance.tail_box.col_bottom_z_m: the collision box of the tail box starts 6 mm above the highest part of a car's nose (the drive model's chassis/col1, front gear case, top at 0.074 m); the LiDAR box keeps the full 0.12 x 0.12 x 0.20 m from 0.0702. With the full box as collision shape the 3.8 mm overlap of the overhanging box's lower edge with the nose of a car behind it turned the contact normal vertical and wedged the nose under the box (first rear-end run)
